text:
sarah: spotted a sharp rise in tiny-gpu pod evictions in us-west2 around 02:04 UTC, apps reporting intermittent 502s.

vincent: looking at scheduler traces: relabel job toggled gpu-arch label on ~25 nodes at 02:03-02:06 and many ampere-affinity pods were bounced. scheduler preempted then failed to bind because nodes briefly had gpu-arch=unknown.

deepa: also saw kube-proxy churn on some hosts (conntrack saturation). API errors made reschedules flakey.

ops-bot: [alert] evictions.spike(us-west2) 7812345678 - 58 evictions in 11m, reschedule-failures 15

vincent: excerpt:
```
E0325 02:04:12 scheduler_extender.go:120] preempting pod model-worker-17 due to label-mismatch: node gpu-arch changed
E0325 02:04:13 binder.go:198] bind failed: required gpu-arch=ampere, node has gpu-arch=unknown
```

sarah: short-term plan: pause the relabel cron in region, scale warm-pool tiny-gpu +3, and apply a scheduler safety: label-stability-window=120s to avoid treating freshly changed nodes as preempt targets.

deepa: bump conntrack on nodes via daemonset to reduce kube-proxy restarts while we stabilize.

vincent: pause command I ran (rollbackable):
```bash
kubectl -n infra patch cronjob reconcile-gpu-families -p '{"spec":{"suspend":true}}' --type=merge
```

sarah: impact estimate: ~30m churn, ~3 GPU-hours wasted, ~+13% cost blip for the hour. We need playbook entries.

deepa: medium-term fixes: two-phase relabeler (staging tag -> verify -> promote), 2m quiesce before any drain/preempt, metric for label-mutation-rate, and default tiny-gpu to disallow fractional-gang while warm-pool autoscale is tuned.

ops-bot: [note] action applied: cron suspended in us-west2 at 7812345705 by sarah

vincent: filing follow-ups: ENG-PLAT-4728 relabeler two-phase, ENG-PLAT-4729 scheduler label-stability flag, ENG-PLAT-4730 conntrack daemonset tuning.

sarah: adding runbook section "Relabeler-induced affinity churn" with rollback commands and watch metrics. Will draft short outage postmortem after 24h. :memo:
